Scenario-Based Statement: Contractors receive safety induction, training and competence preparation appropriate to the risks of their work.
Pahayag sa Filipino: Ang mga contractor ay binibigyan ng safety induction, training, at paghahanda sa kakayahan na naaangkop sa mga panganib ng kanilang trabaho.
Scoring Note: Higher agreement indicates a stronger safety-culture condition.

Scenario-Based Statement: You feel contractors follow the same safety standards as direct-hire employees.

Scenario-Based Statement: You're always invited to join a safety committee or working group.
